verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page says you can 'run payroll on your schedule' and 'process payroll as often as you need — at no extra charge,' which covers runs outside the regular schedule. It also says you can 'add one-off bonuses to payroll in seconds' and set up one-off custom pay types, which covers the bonus case. Missing for 10: explicit off-cycle run documentation, evidence for correction runs and termination/final-pay runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
